### Jordan

❓ Zaki continues to be without Yazan Al-Naimat: the forward is recovering from a serious injury and is hoping to be fit in time for the Asian Cup. Oda Al-Fakhouri has returned to the squad - the Pyramids striker recovered from his injury and started against Syria. During the camp, the coach also called up Anas Al-Awadat.

### Venezuela [...] Venezuela are travelling to Amman without 15 players from their original squad: 12 have been released back to their clubs, and three are missing the entire tour. Six of the remaining 19 could make their international debut. Jordan have their core group together - the same players who featured at the World Cup last summer. Venezuela are yet to win on this tour. We expect Jordan to take advantage of the weakened visitors. The bet is Jordan - Asian Handicap (0). Predicted score: 1-0.

data.title: Jordan vs Venezuela Prediction: 06.10.2026 International Friendly 2026 Preview | Tips.GG
data.content:
Jordan’s recent matches show a team that commits fewer fouls and plays a more patient passing game at home, which could slow the tempo further. Venezuela, on the other hand, carry a heavier disciplinary record from their last five outings, with four yellow cards and 29 fouls logged, a sign Vizcarrondo’s side can get physical when things aren’t flowing. That combination of a patient host and a scrappy visitor points toward a match decided by small margins rather than open football. [...] ### Venezuela possible starting eleven

 GK: José Contreras
 DF: Nahuel Ferraresi, Christian Makoun, Yordan Osorio, Jon Aramburu
 MF: Yangel Herrera, Cristian Casseres, Daniel Pereira, Wikelman Carmona
 FW: Kevin Kelsy, Jesús Ramírez [...] Jordan welcome Venezuela to Amman for a friendly that gives both coaches a chance to test their squads away from competitive pressure. Badou Zaki’s men have been feeding on tougher opposition lately, while Oswaldo Vizcarrondo’s Venezuela arrive off the back of a goalless stalemate with South Korea. The quirky detail here is that both sides scored just once combined in their respective previous outings, a sign that goals might be hard to come by once again in Amman.
